headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 20, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a crucial 8-4 victory over the Miami Marlins, with Michael Harris II leading the offense. In other action, the Cleveland Guardians edged the Detroit Tigers 4-3, while the Tampa Bay Rays took down the Baltimore Orioles 4-1. The Cincinnati Reds also secured a 4-1 win over the Philadelphia Phillies.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Kyle Teel, who has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. Other notable injuries include Lance McCullers Jr. (right shoulder inflammation) and James McCann (strained right quad).

The Tampa Bay Rays made a move on May 19, acquiring 3B Oliver Dunn from the Chicago White Sox in exchange for LHP Joe Rock. The Los Angeles Dodgers also acquired LHP Eric Lauer from the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. Additionally, the Athletics traded CF Junior Perez to the Chicago White Sox for LHP Jackson Nove, and the Athletics traded RHP Kyle Robinson to the Pittsburgh Pirates for 2B Alika Williams.

top_news.title: **Braves Take Down Marlins 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured an 8-4 victory over the Miami Marlins, with Michael Harris II leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Martín Pérez started strong for the Braves, striking out 10 batters in 5 innings.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a hard-fought 4-3 win over the Detroit Tigers, with Colin Holderman earning the win.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Orioles 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Kevin Kelly earning the win. Griffin Jax led the Orioles with 5.0 IP, 6 K, 1 ER, 1 BB, 3 H.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Phillies 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 4-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Chase Burns leading the way on the mound. Burns pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **White Sox Place Kyle Teel on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Chicago White Sox catcher Kyle Teel has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain.

top_news.title: **Rays Acquire Dunn in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays made a move on May 19, 2026, acquiring 3B Oliver Dunn from the Chicago White Sox in exchange for LHP Joe Rock.
